scenes.vo: Lesson ten point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: Professionals don't just take the yield on offer: they engineer it. Fixed rates, hedged carry, option income and managed ranges each swap one risk for another. This module teaches you to build them and say exactly what each one is short.
